$comment: Response headers for every page and file. Used by the CloudFront stack (lib/ledgermatch-stack.ts) and by the end-to-end test server (frontend/e2e/serve.mjs), so the test checks the app under exactly what production sends. Invoice files are parsed in the browser: the page may only load its own files and talk to the analytics endpoint and the AI backend (__AI_ENDPOINT__: the stack puts https://<site host>/api/ there, the e2e server its own /api/ — never the rest of our own server). An invoice goes to the backend only when no reader in the browser can read it and the customer's config turns the AI on. 'wasm-unsafe-eval' lets it compile its own WebAssembly (pdf.js's scan decoder, Tesseract OCR); it does not allow eval() of JavaScript.
